The '''Moon trees''' were levitating [[Tree/Legends|trees]] – or similar structures – that flowered in the interstellar space of the [[Gunninga Gap/Legends|Gunninga Gap]] deep within the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="SM">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref> Among those cosmic trees had dwelled the ancient [[Death/Legends|death]] cult known as the [[Knell of Muspilli]].<ref name="UR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref><ref name="BS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> During the era of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] adept [[Cronal]] discovered scraps of the lost [[Taurannik Codex]] while exploring the drifting lunar trees of the Gunninga Gap.<ref name="SM" />

==Behind the scenes==
In real life, the «[[wikipedia:en:Moon tree|Moon trees]]» were plants that had sprouted from about 500 seeds which had traveled in the personal luggage of [[wikipedia:en:Stuart Roosa|pilot]] of the [[wikipedia:en:Apollo 14|Apollo 14]] spacecraft during its [[wikipedia:en:Moon|Moon]] mission in [[wikipedia:en:1971|1971]].
